title: Boring SaaS ideas for 1 October 2026
dek: Good morning on the beautiful day of 1 October 2026. Here's my revenue notes on 10 products for today. 9 are Stripe-verified and 1 is Paddle-verified.

companies.name: Khosmos
companies.description: Quote + e-sign + invoicing + payments for French construction pros and micro-entreprises (1–50 people / subcontractors). Create a full quote in under a minute, sign on-site or remotely, then bill. ~€24/mo + per-seat, annual plans available.
companies.evidence: ~$21.9k MRR, 834 active subscriptions, ~$24.8k L30, ~$355k all-time, ~12,000 users claimed, founded Mar 2023, France. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Pick one country's trade invoicing/e-sign rules and own quote→pay end-to-end. Switching costs are high once invoices live there.

companies.name: Web3Forms
companies.description: Contact-form API for static sites - HTML form posts land in email/webhook with no backend/PHP. Free tier (250 submissions/mo) + paid upgrades. India-founded, Paddle billing.
companies.evidence: ~$41.0k MRR, 2,971 active subscriptions, ~$44.3k L30, ~$305k all-time, founded Dec 2020, India. Last sync Oct 1, 2026. (Paddle, not Stripe — still payment-provider verified.)
companies.indieAngle: Own one painful "I don't want a server" developer utility, meter submissions, keep the free tier as a funnel.

companies.name: Capgo
companies.description: Live OTA updates + native builds, channels, rollback, and release automation for CapacitorJS apps — ship JS/CSS fixes without waiting on App Store review. Estonia, bootstrapped, team 2–5. Free 14-day trial.
companies.evidence: ~$31.2k MRR, 1,130 active subscriptions, ~$36.6k L30, ~$546k all-time, ~5,000 users claimed, founded Nov 2021, Estonia. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Wrap a popular open framework's missing ops layer (OTA / CI) and charge for reliability + channels — classic boring developer infra.

companies.name: Pushouse
companies.description: WhatsApp automation + e-commerce tools — broadcasts, carts, engagement for merchants who live in WhatsApp (UAE-founded, MENA/global e-com vibe).
companies.evidence: ~$25.9k MRR, 248 active subscriptions, ~$34.2k L30, ~$278k all-time, ~1,500 users claimed, founded Jan 2026, UAE. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Country/channel messaging ops for e-com (WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage) beats another generic email ESP — especially where WhatsApp is default.

companies.name: Helios
companies.description: Engagement / lifecycle platform for growing fitness brands — turn the flood of leads and member activity into actual conversations and retention (sendhelios.com).
companies.evidence: ~$45.3k L30, ~$687k all-time, listed MRR as "No active subscriptions" (treat L30 as the real print signal — mixed/usage billing). ~2,481 users claimed on profile, founded Dec 2020, US. Last sync Oct 1, 2026. UI also surfaces ~$39k as an estimated MRR figure on related cards — prefer L30/all-time here.
companies.indieAngle: Vertical lifecycle messaging for one sweaty niche (fitness, clinics, tutors) with clear ROI on no-shows and churn.

companies.name: ColdSire
companies.description: Premium cold-email inbox infrastructure - Google/Microsoft mailboxes from a pool mixed with real businesses, ~$6/mo per account, pitched at deliverability.
companies.evidence: ~$15.6k MRR, 909 active subscriptions, ~$15.3k L30, ~$1.04M all-time, ~5,000 users claimed, founded May 2023, US. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Sell the boring dependency under a hot category (cold email) - inboxes, domains, warming — not another AI writer.

companies.name: Hirevire
companies.description: Async video interview tool — candidates answer your questions on camera; hiring managers review without scheduling. Plans ~$49 / $149 / $249/mo. India-founded, bootstrapped, team 2–5.
companies.evidence: ~$13.8k MRR, 162 active subscriptions, ~$14.9k L30, ~$267k all-time, ~180 users claimed, founded Dec 2021, India. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Own one step of hiring (async screen, reference checks, offer letters) for a vertical instead of building a full HRIS.

companies.name: LegalOne
companies.description: French *annonces légales* (legal notices) publishing — accountants and companies file required notices with competitive rates and compliance baked in. Bootstrapped, France.
companies.evidence: ~$10.7k L30, ~$93k all-time, MRR listed as none / no active subscriptions (pay-per-notice model). Founded Oct 2025, France. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Digitize a mandatory local filing (legal notices, permits, company registry forms) and sell through accountants who already do the paperwork.

companies.name: Promatic
companies.description: Permit automation for residential plumbing & HVAC contractors — file/manage permits and inspections so jobs aren't stuck waiting on paperwork. ~$99 per project.
companies.evidence: ~$6.9k L30, ~$15.7k all-time, MRR listed as none (project billing at $99/job), founded May 2025, US. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: One trade × one bureaucracy (HVAC permits, electrical inspections, dumpster permits) with per-job pricing is an indie-sized wedge.

companies.name: VoxNow
companies.description: Voicemail → email transcription/summary + instant SMS reply for Belgian law firms. ~€90/user/mo. Small team (2–5), founded mid-2025.
companies.evidence: ~$3.1k MRR, 26 active subscriptions, ~$3.7k L30, ~$23k all-time, ~20 users claimed, founded Jul 2025, Belgium. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Voicemail/SMS reception for one regulated profession in one country — high willingness to pay, tiny sales motion.

honorableMentions.name: Tutti
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified WhatsApp ERP for LatAm construction trades; ~$1.3k MRR / 37 subs / ~$2.4k L30 / ~$16k all-time. Earliest-stage Conductor-shaped chat ERP.

honorableMentions.name: NDISCompliant
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified AU NDIS SIL audit document packs; ~$8.0k L30 / ~$45k all-time; ~$297 one-time (compliance pack, not seat SaaS).

honorableMentions.name: Fidelatoo
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified FR digital loyalty cards for local shops; ~$6.9k MRR / 239 subs / ~$7.5k L30 / ~$164k all-time.

honorableMentions.name: Data Bloo
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified Looker Studio templates/connectors; ~$6.1k MRR / 219 subs / ~$8.7k L30 / ~$654k all-time (one-time-heavy packaging).

honorableMentions.name: isMalicious
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified threat-intel API for SIEM/MSSPs; ~$2.0k MRR / 16 subs / ~$1.8k L30 / ~$14k all-time; for sale on marketplace.

honorableMentions.name: car-docs.ro
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified Romanian car sale-purchase contracts; ~$834 L30 / ~$14k all-time; ~30 RON one-shot — ultra-local form glue.

honorableMentions.name: AltIndex
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified alternative-data stock scores + API; ~$16.9k MRR / 676 subs / ~$11.0k L30 / ~$663k all-time (fintech, less "boring ops").
